definitions.explanation: Describes something with very fine detail, precision, or resolution. Often used for visual quality, craftsmanship, or analysis.

examples.japanese: {精細|せいさい}な⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{画面|がめん}→画面：04406_gamen⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{非常|ひじょう}→非常：01598_hijou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{精細|せいさい}で⟦{美|うつく}しい→美しい：01121_utsukushii⟧。
examples.english: This screen is extremely fine-detailed and beautiful.

examples.japanese: ⟦{職人|しょくにん}→職人：09868_shokunin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{精細|せいさい}な⟦{技術|ぎじゅつ}→技術：01389_gijutsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ{一|ひと}つ→一つ一つ：27163_hitotsuhitotsu⟧⟦{手作|てづく}り→手作り：08300_tezukuri⟧⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Craftsmen make each piece by hand with meticulous technique.

notes:
A compound of {精|せい} (fine/refined) and {細|さい} (detailed/minute). Functions as a na-adjective, modifying nouns with な. Very commonly seen in technical contexts relating to display resolution.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精細|せいさい}な⟦{描写|びょうしゃ}→描写：05516_byousha⟧: detailed depiction
- {精細|せいさい}な⟦{画像|がぞう}→画像：13549_gazou⟧: high-resolution image
- ⟦{高|こう}→高〜：03951_kou⟧{精細|せいさい}: high-definition, high-resolution
- {精細|せいさい}な⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: meticulous work

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{緻密|ちみつ}→緻密：07915_chimitsu⟧: meticulous, elaborate — emphasizes thoroughness and careful planning
- ⟦{繊細|せんさい}→繊細：07607_sensai⟧: delicate, sensitive — can describe personality or aesthetics; broader usage
- ⟦{詳細|しょうさい}→詳細：02523_shousai⟧: detailed (information) — used for written/verbal details rather than visual fineness
- ⟦{制裁|せいさい}→制裁：11846_seisai⟧: sanctions, punishment — a homophone with unrelated meaning
